description: Wait until the program is blocked waiting for input and nothing on screen has changed for quietMs, then return its state. Use it instead of fixed sleeps after craftos_type, craftos_key, craftos_send_event or a network change; craftos_act already settles by itself.

quietMs.description: How long the screen must stay unchanged.

timeoutMs.description: Give up after this long (the result says it timed out).

name: craftos_settle
